title: Attendance Rate Table for the In-Person Appointments No-Show Fee
content:
**Rate table.** The visit type's no-show fee is raised, for the no-show fee a missed In-Person Appointments visit carries, according to the appointment fee charges on the ledger of the patient's Patient Financial Account. Charges are counted when they are no-show fee or late-cancellation fee charges posted with a date of service less than 12 whole months before the day the fee is decided.

| Ledger inside the 12 whole months | Treatment of the visit type's no-show fee |
|---|---|
| 2 or more such charges, at least one of them a no-show fee | Raised by half: multiplied by 1.5 |
| At least 1 such charge but not that combination | Raised by a quarter: multiplied by 1.25 |
| None | Taken as it stands: multiplied by 1 |

Charges of any other kind, such as virtual-visit fees, are not counted for the no-show fee the missed visit carries.

**Combinations.**

| No-show fee charges | Late-cancellation fee charges | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0 | 1 |
| 0 | 1 | 1.25 |
| 0 | 3 | 1.25 |
| 1 | 0 | 1.25 |
| 1 | 1 | 1.5 |
| 3 | 0 | 1.5 |

**Hypothetical figures.** For a New Patient Office Visit, no-show fee $75.00: at 1.25 the raised figure is $93.75; at 1.5 it is $112.50. A ledger holding only a virtual-visit fee charge inside the window leaves the rate at 1.
